tools.name: search_offers
tools.description: Find current shop offers and voucher deals in Australia, the United Kingdom and the United States by keyword, country, category, shop, product brand or specifications. Use when someone is shopping for a product, brand or shop and wants to check current offers, savings and conditions before buying. E

tools.name: get_offer
tools.description: Read the full public details of one current offer, including its description, shop, savings, conditions and dates, using the exact id returned by search_offers. Voucher codes are not included.

tools.name: list_filters
tools.description: List countries, categories, product brands and product types with current offer counts. Use before filtering search_offers by category, brand, product type or specifications. Supply a brand or product type to see its specification filters.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "search_offers" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
